challenge_ceiling.predicate: generated best-proven exact bits reaches the 120-bit challenge ceiling

dominated.predicate: another surviving point is no worse in generated-proven bits, bytes, time, RSS, A/B shape, and active/64/96 gas and strictly better in at least one

unbuildable.predicate: degree > 2^blowup, fold log arity > available depth, cap > LDE height, or non-hiding parameters

retainedGateSummary.reason: Null/unmeasured complete-transaction gas cannot pass; projected values are bounds only.

securityFilterMethod: Independent calculator UDR/LDR at the grid-maximum 32/32 grinding first; when that generated-proven upper bound is below 100, all 25 lower-grinding combinations reject without redundant evaluation.
